rebase_errors.branch_tip: Another branch points at this commit and would lose it; drop it in the interactive rebase panel instead.
rebase_errors.changed: The commits to rebase changed; reload the list and try again.
rebase_errors.combine_after_merge: A squash or fixup must follow the commit it melds into, not a merge, label or reset step.
rebase_errors.combine_after_step: Move the exec or break step below the squash or fixup: it must follow the commit it combines with.
rebase_errors.commit_not_on_branch: {commit} is not on the current branch
rebase_errors.detached: Check out a branch to rebase it.
rebase_errors.drops_everything: Dropping every commit of the branch isn't supported.
rebase_errors.empty_combined: The combined commit's message can't be empty.
rebase_errors.exec_one_line: An exec command must be one line.
rebase_errors.first_combines: The first commit can't be squashed or fixed up: there is no earlier commit in the list to combine it with.
rebase_errors.held.elsewhere: {alias} points at {target}, which is checked out in another worktree; git would move {target} with this rebase (rebase.updateRefs). Delete {alias} or switch that worktree to another branch first.
rebase_errors.held.not_branch: {alias} points at {target}, which isn't a local branch; git would move it with this rebase (rebase.updateRefs). Delete {alias} first.
rebase_errors.lost_to_reset: A commit just before a reset step would be left out of the branch. Move it below the reset, or above the label that ends its line.
rebase_errors.merge_selected: Merge commits can't be edited this way.
rebase_errors.no_commits_yet: The branch has no commits yet.
rebase_errors.not_consecutive: Select commits that follow one another to squash them.
rebase_errors.not_interactive: Only an interactive rebase's remaining steps can be edited.
rebase_errors.not_moved: git won't move {branches} with this rebase, though the list does: check rebase.updateRefs and the git you run, and try again.
rebase_errors.not_moved.elsewhere: git won't move {branches} with this rebase (rebase.updateRefs), though the list does. Switch that worktree to another branch, or turn rebase.updateRefs off, and try again.
rebase_errors.not_on_branch: This commit isn't on the current branch.
rebase_errors.not_utf8: A branch whose name isn't valid UTF-8 points at a commit of this rebase, and git would move it (rebase.updateRefs). Rename it first.
rebase_errors.nothing_to_rebase: {branch} has no commits that aren't already on {onto}
rebase_errors.parent_merge: Its parent is a merge commit, which can't be squashed into.
rebase_errors.refs_changed: The branches this rebase moves (rebase.updateRefs) changed; reload the list and try again.
rebase_errors.root_squash: The first commit has no parent to squash it into.
rebase_errors.side_line: This commit came in through a merge; edit it in the interactive rebase panel instead.
rebase_errors.some_branch_tips: Another branch points at a selected commit and would lose it; drop them in the interactive rebase panel instead.
rebase_errors.some_merge_selected: The selection includes a merge commit.
rebase_errors.some_not_on_branch: Some selected commits aren't on the current branch.
rebase_errors.some_side_line: Some selected commits came in through a merge; edit them in the interactive rebase panel instead.
rebase_errors.split_by_branch: Another branch starts between these commits; squash them in the interactive rebase panel instead.
rebase_errors.stack_changed: The stack changed since this restack was planned. Try again.
rebase_errors.stale: The branch changed since this list was made. Reset to reload it.
rebase_errors.still_rebasing: The restack's rebase is still in progress.
rebase_errors.todo_moved: The rebase moved on since this list was read. Reset to reload it.
rebase_errors.too_few_to_squash: Select two or more commits to squash them.
rebase_errors.unsupported_steps: The remaining steps include merge, label or reset commands, which this panel can't edit yet. Use git rebase --edit-todo in a terminal.
rebase_errors.update_ref_in_group: The remaining steps move a branch between a commit and a squash or fixup into it, which this panel can't keep as it is. Use git rebase --edit-todo in a terminal.
